findings.name: Files tab of a pull request whose branch is already in the target shows a blank page with the raw text "after commit not found in PR commits" (HTTP 400)
findings.summary: The page is blank white and shows the raw internal string 'after commit not found in PR commits' with no navigation, no message and no way on; the response status is HTTP 400. It happens every time this address is opened (load, reload and a fresh navigation). (on /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5/files)
findings.expected: The Files tab should render the normal page chrome with an empty diff or a readable message such as 'This branch is already included in the target branch', the way the Conversation tab does.
findings.actual: The page is blank white and shows the raw internal string 'after commit not found in PR commits' with no navigation, no message and no way on; the response status is HTTP 400. It happens every time this address is opened (load, reload and a fresh navigation).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6dtbtklp3c8hdj643mx8.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/5 (the pull request 'agent9-inline-comments: Document release captain and verification responsibilities', head branch docs/release-owners, base main).

Its conversation now says 'wants to merge 0 commits' and 'This branch is already included in the target branch. There is nothing to merge.' (the head branch was merged into main by another pull request).

The branch page for agent6-talk-1 attributes agent12-main-note.md and agent12-main-note2.md to the commit "agent6 add talk test file", and PR #15's header shows "Commits 1" beside "Files Changed 4 / +8". The PR merge box then reports "This pull request has changes conflicting with the target branch: docs/releases.md" — a file my commit never touched. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/commit/21d462fe29f38a869c65653fc1e38ddd69b29859 and /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/15)
findings.expected: The commit adds exactly one file (docs/agent6-talk-1.md), so its page should say 1 changed file / 1 addition, the PR should show Commits 1 with Files Changed 1, and no conflict in a file I never touched.
findings.actual: The commit page says "4 changed files with 8 additions" and lists agent12-main-note.md (content "agent12 note committed directly to main to make the open PR out of date."), agent12-main-note2.md (content "second agent12 note on main") and docs/releases.md as added by my commit, though I only created docs/agent6-talk-1.md. The branch page for agent6-talk-1 attributes agent12-main-note.md and agent12-main-note2.md to the commit "agent6 add talk test file", and PR #15's header shows "Commits 1" beside "Files Changed 4 / +8". The PR merge box then reports "This pull request has changes conflicting with the target branch: docs/releases.md" — a file my commit never touched.

findings.name: Global /pulls with state=all lists only open pull requests while its counters say 2 Closed
findings.summary: The list shows only the open pull request 'agent7-life-2' (#19). The two closed pull requests (#22 merged, #7 closed) are missing although the page's counters read '1 Open' and '2 Closed'. The repository-level list /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls?q=agent7&state=all shows all three rows for the same filter, and /pulls?q=agent7&state=closed shows the two closed ones, so state=all behaves differently only on the global page. (on /pulls)
findings.expected: With state=all the result list should contain every pull request matching the search in every state: the open 'agent7-life-2' (#19) plus the two closed ones, 'agent7-merge-3: merge state check' (#22, merged) and 'agent7 lifecycle: Document release captain and verification responsibilities' (#7, closed) — exactly the numbers the page's own counters show (1 Open, 2 Closed), and the same rows the repository-level list returns for the same search and state.
findings.actual: The list shows only the open pull request 'agent7-life-2' (#19). The two closed pull requests (#22 merged, #7 closed) are missing although the page's counters read '1 Open' and '2 Closed'. The repository-level list /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls?q=agent7&state=all shows all three rows for the same filter, and /pulls?q=agent7&state=closed shows the two closed ones, so state=all behaves differently only on the global page.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1.
Open https://5503-i6dtbtklp3c8hdj643mx8.e2b.app/pulls?q=agent7&state=all (search box value 'agent7', state=all).

findings.name: Creating a pull request as a non-collaborator answers a garbled \"Push Failed … Review the Git Hooks\" error
findings.summary: A red toast says \"Push Failed: The push was rejected. Review the Git Hooks for this repository. You must be a collaborator to create pull request.\" The POST to /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 answers 400 Bad Request and the console logs a failed resource; the form stays on screen with the title still filled in. Nothing was pushed and no pull request was created, so the \"Push Failed / Git Hooks\" wording describes an action that never happened. (on /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2)
findings.expected: Either no create form is offered to a user without write access (the compare page/button should say that alex cannot open a pull request in this repository), or the failure is stated plainly, e.g. "You must be a collaborator to create pull request", without mentioning push or Git hooks.
findings.actual: A red toast says \"Push Failed: The push was rejected. Review the Git Hooks for this repository. You must be a collaborator to create pull request.\" The POST to /agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 answers 400 Bad Request and the console logs a failed resource; the form stays on screen with the title still filled in. Nothing was pushed and no pull request was created, so the \"Push Failed / Git Hooks\" wording describes an action that never happened.
reproSteps: Sign out of eval and sign in as alex (alex / momentic-contributor-1), who is not a member of the organization agent15org.
Open https://5503-i6dtbtklp3c8hdj643mx8.e2b.app/agent15org/agent15repo/compare/main...agent15-branch-2 (branch agent15-branch-2 of the public org repo agent15org/agent15repo against main).
Click the "New Pull Request" button to open the create form.
Type "agent15-alex-pr third file" in the Title field and click "Create Pull Request".

findings.name: After signing out, the browser Back button still shows the private repository's pull request conversation and Files tab with the signed-in header and interactive controls
findings.summary: Both earlier pages come back from the browser's back-forward cache exactly as they were before signing out: the top-right still shows the signed-in eval avatar instead of "Sign In", the PR conversation still shows "Owner", "Edit", the merge box with "Update branch by merge" and the comment editor, and the Files tab still shows the full diff of all 3 files with "1 / 3 files viewed" and the Review button. Only a reload shows the truth — it redirects to /user/login, proving the session is gone and the pages are private-repository content. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/16)
findings.expected: After signing out, Back should not show the private repository's pull request pages with the signed-in header and working-looking controls; the person should get the sign-in page (or a clearly anonymous, read-only view) instead of cached authenticated content.
findings.actual: Both earlier pages come back from the browser's back-forward cache exactly as they were before signing out: the top-right still shows the signed-in eval avatar instead of "Sign In", the PR conversation still shows "Owner", "Edit", the merge box with "Update branch by merge" and the comment editor, and the Files tab still shows the full diff of all 3 files with "1 / 3 files viewed" and the Review button. Only a reload shows the truth — it redirects to /user/login, proving the session is gone and the pages are private-repository content.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-i6dtbtklp3c8hdj643mx8.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/pulls/16 (also visit its Files Changed tab /files).
Open the avatar menu at the top right and click "Sign Out": the site returns to the signed-out home page.
Press the browser's Back button once: the pull request conversation /16 comes back fully rendered with the signed-in header, Owner badge, Edit button, merge box and comment editor.
Press Back again: the /16/files tab also comes back fully rendered with its diff and Review button. Reloading that address then redirects to /user/login.
